name: k-place
js: document.querySelector('#k-mode [data-v=place]').click(); const t=UI.tabs.koordinaten.state.task; const s=document.getElementById('k-svg'); const p=s.createSVGPoint(); p.x=90+(t.y+5)*46; p.y=40+(5-t.x)*46; const q=p.matrixTransform(s.getScreenCTM()); s.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{clientX:q.x,clientY:q.y,bubbles:true,pointerId:1})); JSON.stringify(t)+' | '+document.getElementById('k-feedback').textContent

name: a-quiz
js: document.querySelector('#a-rules [data-key=widths]').click(); document.querySelector('#a-dir [data-v=parallel]').click(); document.querySelector('#a-unit [data-v=between]').click(); document.getElementById('a-new').click(); const f=[...UI.tabs.aufbau.state.faults]; const box=document.querySelector('#a-faults input[data-k='+f[0]+']'); box.click(); document.querySelector('#a-faults input[data-k=upright]').click(); document.getElementById('a-check').click(); f.join(',')+' | '+document.getElementById('a-feedback').textContent

name: s-hover
js: function mv(id,vx,vy){const s=document.getElementById(id);const p=s.createSVGPoint();p.x=vx;p.y=vy;const q=p.matrixTransform(s.getScreenCTM());s.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove',{clientX:q.x,clientY:q.y,bubbles:true}));} mv('l-svg',351.4,200); mv('s-cut',246,150); document.getElementById('l-readout').textContent+' | '+document.getElementById('s-readout').textContent
